scientific_limitations: Independent identically distributed categorical observations with strictly positive known probabilities.
Cyclic case needs at least three observations; Pearson limit keeps alphabet size and probabilities fixed.
Older overlapping-word enumeration papers could contain an implicit spectral consequence; full-text priority comparison remains incomplete.
Finite exact enumeration is a reproducibility check, not a substitute for analytic proof.
title: Universal weighted covariance spectrum and path-to-cycle rank loss for categorical bigram counts
